description: The number of carries when a and b are added in prime base p. By Kummer, that is the exponent of p in C(a+b, a). Adding 5 and 3 in base 2 makes 3 carries. A composite base is rejected. a and b run from 0 to 1000000000000, and p runs from 2 to 1000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/kummer
